Yes, this feels right. When I left the name blank and typed an address without the http part, the form stayed open instead of losing what I'd entered, and it showed a clear message right under each field telling me what to fix — "add a name" and "enter a full web address beginning with http:// or https://". Nothing got saved until I corrected the problems.

That's exactly the kind of gentle catch I'd want so I don't end up with a nameless or broken bookmark. This works for me.
